evals.name: handoff-has-uncommitted-and-why
evals.prompt: (src/export.py has uncommitted half-done changes) I'm out of credits, hand off.
evals.expected_output: Writes a handoff section that lists src/export.py as uncommitted and says why, and leaves the half-done change out of any commit.
assertions: The section lists src/export.py as uncommitted, with the reason
The half-done change is not committed

evals.name: commits-only-handoff-file
evals.prompt: (src/export.py has uncommitted half-done changes) I'm out of credits, hand off.
evals.expected_output: Commits the handoff file on its own, with git commit -- HANDOFF.md or an equivalent that leaves src/export.py out.
assertions: The commit includes only HANDOFF.md (git commit -- HANDOFF.md, or an equivalent)

evals.name: pickup-by-topic
evals.prompt: (HANDOFF.md has open sections 'billing export' (older) and 'login page' (newer)) Pick up the billing export handoff.
evals.expected_output: Reads the billing export section rather than the newest one, marks it picked up, and runs git log and git status before continuing.
assertions: The billing export section is read, not the newest one
git log and git status are run

evals.name: no-open-sections-asks
evals.prompt: (HANDOFF.md has two open sections) Pick up where we left off.
evals.expected_output: Lists both open sections and asks which one to pick up, starting neither.
assertions: The reply asks which one to pick up
Neither is started before the answer
